headlines.text: 2022 brought us this moment: history was made as FTR vs. The Young Bucks contested the very first AAA World Tag Team Titles match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 9.00 ? a stone-cold classic. A rematch of a modern classic ? both teams left it all in the ring for the ROH/AAA Tag Team Titles, in a show that also saw Samoa Joe's AEW in-ring debut, in a stacked night widely praised as one of the best episodes of the year.

Back on this day in 2025, Kenny Omega vs. Mike Bailey vs. Ricochet fought tooth and nail for the AEW International Title, appearing on Dynasty, rated 9.14 ? a match fans still talk about. For Mike Bailey, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Omega and Bailey briefly aligned against Ricochet before Omega finished with an avalanche One Winged Angel, retaining the International Title in a match Tony Schiavone called one for the ages.
On a Saturday in 2024, back when it was the first-ever encounter between Penta El Zero M and Komander, headlining the show on Collision, rated 7.43 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2025, the AEW TNT Title changed hands as Adam Cole vs. Daniel Garcia battled it out in a No Time Limit match, appearing on Dynasty, rated 5.65 ? ending the champion's reign at 7 defenses. Cole capitalized on Garcia's frustration, hitting a pair of Panama Sunrises and a running knee to win his first singles championship in AEW, the TNT Title.

Looking back to 2025, when gold changed shoulders as the ROH World Heavyweight Title found a new champion as Bandido vs. Chris Jericho battled it out, appearing on Dynasty, rated 4.64 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. Bandido's family exposed Jericho's hidden baseball bat to force a restart, and Bandido capitalized with the 21 Plex to win the ROH World Championship while keeping his mask.
That Sunday in 2025, Castagnoli, PAC & Yuta vs. Rated FTR went to battle over the AEW World Trios Titles, appearing on Dynasty, rated 6.91. Rated FTR was challenging for gold for the very first time.
